score_semantics: JD能力要求的个人证据覆盖分，不是面试概率；权重由岗位决定，不为候选人调权

direct_full.label: 同类能力及结果证据完整

direct_partial.label: 同类能力已做过，规模或结果证据仍不完整

transfer_strong.label: 业务机制相通，客户或产品链路不同

transfer_partial.label: 部分相邻实践，关键环节未证明

gap.label: 已有确认表明缺少要求的经历/成果

unknown.label: 材料不足不能判断，按未举证计分，不代表没有能力

hard_gates: Separate met/unmet/unknown; scores never override a gate
resume_reuse: Score >=80 alone never authorizes reuse, rewriting or sending

company_tiers.denominator: distinct identity-reviewed employers with traceable job samples; seeds, brands and repeated observations do not count
